Maya: Quick heads-up — planning a tf apply to prod-controlplane during the 02:00 UTC quiet window in ~30m. will take an IAM snapshot first. @Dave can you confirm the snapshot script is good? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Dave: Yep, running the snapshot now. command I use: `aws iam list-policies --scope Local > iam-policies-$(date +%s).json` and `terraform state pull > state-prod.json`. done in ~2m.
Maya: Awesome. Deploy flow: canary on controlplane-1 -> wait 10m -> full fanout if metrics OK. rollback criteria: >5% auth failures OR any role binding regressions.
Sarah: Quick note: we need to pin provider to avoid drift. I pushed `provider "aws" { version = "~> 4.50" }` to the apply branch. also set `prevent_destroy = true` on core roles.
Lin: Added release note snippet in PR: "Pin AWS provider, IAM snapshot before apply, canary rollout + rollback thresholds." Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/812
deploybot: INFO queued apply job 87421 on branch `release/2026-03-21` -> target workspace `prod`. Scheduled start 5501112400. To cancel: `@deploybot cancel 87421`.
Dave: Confirmed snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-ops-backups/iam/5501112222.json. check perms: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-ops-backups/iam/`
Maya: Also added a soft-lock: deploybot will refuse auto-fanout if canary p50 latency delta > 100ms or error-rate jump > +3pp. manual override allowed with two approvers.
Sarah: Reminder for rollback play: if triggered -> deploybot cancel 87421, revert the merge (revert PR), then `terraform apply -var-file=prev-vars.tfvars` against pinned provider version. I'll put the exact commands in runbook.
oncall-bot: health-checks OK for controlplane-1/2. no unusual alarms in last 15m.
Lin: small config ask — can we set `max_batch_time = "10ms"` on the lambda that updates roles? Otherwise canary may backpressure. Pushed a minimal change to the branch.
Maya: ok starting the canary at scheduled time. will post status updates here. if anyone sees anything suspicious ping with @here and include logs. :raised_hands:
__notes: thread about deploybot scheduling, IAM snapshot, provider pinning, rollback criteria, and release note/link. single continuous string of short Slack-style messages.
